name: Average spine
about: A typical adult spine with no sideways curve, stacked from general measurements. Start here and shape it into your own.

name: One curve in the chest
about: A single sideways curve of 45° from T5 to T12, bowing to the right, with the bodies turned. A place to start if your curve is in the upper back.

name: One curve in the lower back
about: A single sideways curve of 35° from T11 to L4, bowing to the left.

name: Two curves, an S shape
about: A curve of 50° to the right in the chest and one of 40° to the left in the lower back.

name: Fusion with rods and screws
about: What is left of an S shape after surgery: fused from T4 to L4, with hooks on the top two levels, screws below, two rods and two cross-links. Made up, not a real person.

name: A real spine: scoliosis fusion, T4 to L2, rods to L4
about: Made from the CT, MRI and X-rays of the person who started this project, shared by him as an example. Positions are his real ones. The bone shapes are drawn by the app.
